name: astro-coming-soon-countdown
description: ⏱️ Astro coming-soon countdown page with honest timer logic, SVG signal motion, and machine-readable launch status metadata.

paragraphs: Astro coming-soon countdown page with honest timing and machine-readable launch status
A sharp single-page launch site that keeps the message simple: one honest countdown, one animated SVG signal clock, and one machine-readable launch-status feed for SEO and tooling.
features: Minimal Astro launch page with a real countdown that stops at zero in production
Optional ?loop=1 dev mode that rolls the countdown forward by the original interval for endless demos
Custom SVG signal clock with purposeful motion instead of heavy animation libraries
Machine-readable /launch-status.json endpoint for bots, previews, dashboards, and richer indexing
Structured data via Organization, SoftwareApplication, Event, and FAQPage JSON-LD

whatItDoes.text: Astro coming-soon countdown page with honest timing and machine-readable launch status
